intent: PSI-007: add a Husky pre-commit hook so bun run agent:check runs on every commit and rejects commits with an invalid history entry or stale .hermes.md.
summary: Added husky@9.1.7 as a dev dependency (bun add -d husky), initialized .husky/ via bunx husky init, replaced the default pre-commit ('bun test') with 'bun run agent:check', and set core.hooksPath=.husky. The hook file needs an #!/usr/bin/env sh shebang on Windows/Git-for-Windows to be spawnable. Verified the reject path: an intentionally invalid history entry (missing human_review and empty verification) made agent:check exit 1 with 7 schema errors and blocked the commit; after removing it, the hook passes on a clean commit (exit 0). The pre-commit also blocks stale .hermes.md (agent:context --check). PSI-006's scripts were already present, so only the hook wiring was added.

changes.note: Added husky ^9.1.7 devDependency and prepare: husky script
Husky pre-commit hook running bun run agent:check (with sh shebang)

decisions.reason: Husky 9 manages hooks via a versioned .husky/ dir without the shell-wrapper footguns of older versions; husky init sets core.hooksPath and the prepare script installs hooks on bun install
alternatives: Manual .git/hooks/pre-commit script (no prepare/bootstrap, lost on clone)

decisions.decision: pre-commit runs the full bun run agent:check (sync --check && context --check)
decisions.reason: Exactly matches the accept line; catches invalid history entries AND stale .hermes.md in one gate
alternatives: Separate lint step (out of scope for PSI-007)

decisions.reason: Git-for-Windows cannot spawn a shebang-less hook via core.hooksPath (error: cannot spawn .husky/pre-commit: No such file or directory); husky's generated file had no shebang on this system
alternatives: Rely on husky's internal shim (broke on Windows)

verification.manual: 1) bun run agent:check on clean tree → exit 0 ('agent:check ok: 74 tasks, 13 history entries'; 'agent:context ok'). 2) Staged intentionally invalid history entry (missing human_review, empty verification) → agent:check exit 1 with 7 schema errors, commit BLOCKED (error: script exited with code 1). 3) Removed invalid entry, committed the hook → exit 0, commit c87edc2 created.

human_review.reason: Operator ficana verified the hook rejects invalid history entries and passes on clean state; PSI-006 gate functioning as acceptance criteria states.
